staticText: Deterministic local digit-shape converter for three Unicode families: Western 0-9, Arabic-Indic U+0660-U+0669 and Eastern Arabic-Indic U+06F0-U+06F9. It preserves surrounding text and logical digit order, including mixed bidirectional text. It does not translate Arabic language, parse numeric meaning, currency or locale, or infer text direction. Copy, TXT and print-to-PDF stay local and no raw input is persisted. The digit mappings follow the Unicode code points for the three decimal-digit families.
